courses.summary: 謝拜位於魯卜哈利沙漠；偏遠沙漠場景使熱負荷、維修運輸與庫存緩衝成為鮮明課題。本課依序分析沙漠散熱條件、偏遠備件等待、補給中斷緩衝、長距液相輸送、遠端資料完整性，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Shaybah lies in the Rub al-Khali desert, making heat load, maintenance transport and inventory buffering useful case themes. The course analyses desert heat-rejection conditions, remote spare-part waiting, supply-interruption buffer, long-distance liquid transfer, remote-data completeness, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
